long_biography.plain_text:
Frank McKee's first property projects were garden apartments built alongside his father in the 1970s. The enterprise had begun with his grandfather, Frank A. McKee, but the younger McKee took it into new residential markets. As president, he developed active-adult communities across the Mid-Atlantic and broadened its holdings beyond homes into apartments, office buildings and self-storage facilities. The company also added a New Jersey marina and marine brokerage, a smaller extension of its property and service business.

McKee retained a controlling interest while bringing his children into the firm. Jennifer worked in manufactured housing, Kate in investment properties and his son Frank Jr. in land acquisition and development. The group continues to describe itself as a family-owned real-estate company, with several generations' work reflected in its portfolio.
